import csv, sys, collections
import numpy as np

def read_pvar_pos(fn, ids=False):
    # returns mapping rawcolname -> (pos, ref_allele, id/pos)
    # rawcolname = id_ref or pos_ref
    m=collections.OrderedDict()
    with open(fn) as f:
        for line in f:
            if line.startswith('#'): continue
            parts=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
            chrom,pos,vid,ref,alt=parts[0],parts[1],parts[2],parts[3],parts[4]
            key=vid+'_'+ref
            # For target IDs can duplicate; for ref pos unique maybe also duplicates with same ref
            if key not in m:
                m[key]=(pos,ref,vid)
    return m

def read_raw(fn, pvar_map):
    with open(fn) as f:
        header=f.readline().rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
        # first six are FID IID PAT MAT SEX PHENOTYPE
        fixed=header[:6]
        colnames=header[6:]
        # map each column index to position/ref using pvar_map; if duplicate, use first.
        maps=[]; cols_used=[]; seen=set()
        for i,c in enumerate(colnames):
            if c in pvar_map:
                p,ref,vid=pvar_map[c]
                key=(p,ref)
                if key not in seen:
                    seen.add(key)
                    cols_used.append((i+6,key,p,ref,vid,c))
        rows=[]
        samples=[]
        for line in f:
            parts=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
            samples.append(parts[1])
            vals=[]
            for idx,key,p,ref,vid,c in cols_used:
                vals.append(int(parts[idx]))
            rows.append(vals)
    X=np.array(rows,dtype=np.int8)
    colkeys=[x[1] for x in cols_used]
    return samples, X, cols_used, colkeys

def align(target, ref):
    # align common colkeys by (pos,ref)
    t_samples,tX,tcols,tkeys=target
    r_samples,rX,rcols,rkeys=ref
    rmap={k:i for i,k in enumerate(rkeys)}
    t_idx=[]; r_idx=[]
    for i,k in enumerate(tkeys):
        if k in rmap:
            t_idx.append(i); r_idx.append(rmap[k])
    return t_samples,tX[:,t_idx], [tcols[i] for i in t_idx], r_samples, rX[:,r_idx], [rcols[i] for i in r_idx]

if __name__=='__main__':
    tmap=read_pvar_pos('match.genotypes.1.1.pvar')
    rmap=read_pvar_pos('match.genotypes.1.3.pvar')
    print('pvar col maps',len(tmap),len(rmap))
    target=read_raw('target_abo.raw',tmap)
    ref=read_raw('ref_abo.raw',rmap)
    print('raw', target[0], target[1].shape, ref[0][:5], ref[1].shape)
    ts,tX,tcols,rs,rX,rcols=align(target,ref)
    print('aligned',tX.shape, rX.shape)
    np.savez('abo_aligned.npz', ts=ts, tX=tX, rs=rs, rX=rX,
             tcols=np.array([[c[1],c[2],c[3],c[4]] for c in tcols], dtype=object),
             rcols=np.array([[c[1],c[2],c[3],c[4]] for c in rcols], dtype=object),
             allow_pickle=True)
    # save causal from ref
    for key in [('133255928','C'),('133255935','G'),('133257521','T')]:
        for i,c in enumerate(ref[2]):
            if c[1][0]==key[0] and c[1][1]==key[1]:
                print('causal',key,'col',i,'sample vals',rX[:,i])
